title: Add Propose Day message extension and illustration to Note screen

requirements.summary: Append the provided Propose Day message (with exact line breaks/punctuation) after the existing Note text without changing the existing content.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Note screen, the existing note text remains unchanged and still appears.

The Note screen additionally displays the two new lines exactly:
- "Happy Propose Day"
- "Life will be more beautiful if you are with me."
Line breaks are preserved (the two lines appear on separate lines).

file_operations.description: Update the note message string to append (after the existing text) a blank line and then the exact provided two-line Propose Day message. Preserve line breaks by keeping the existing whitespace handling (e.g., the current whitespace-pre-line behavior).

requirements.summary: Add a static Propose Day themed illustration (boy kneeling proposing to girl) as a generated image asset and render it on the Note screen only, without any backend fetch.
acceptanceCriteria: A new image file is added under frontend/public/assets/generated and is referenced directly from the Note screen via a /assets/generated/... path.
The illustration is visible on the Note screen alongside the note text (not on the cover, question, or celebration screens).
The frontend does not fetch the illustration from the backend; it is served as a static asset.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static illustration asset matching the required scene and palette: "Romantic illustration of a boy kneeling on one knee proposing to a girl while wishing her Happy Propose Day, soft pink/romantic palette".

Render the static illustration from frontend/public by adding an referencing /assets/generated/propose-day-scene.dim_1024x768.png on the Note screen alongside the note text (and only on this screen). Ensure it is not loaded via any backend call.
